# Class 8 original-workbook interactive lab

Source only: MindMetrix_Class8_CSL_Word_Ready.docx, Library version 20. Source identity and SHA-256 are recorded in book-data.js. No outside images, generated wildlife observations, prices or event outcomes are supplied.

- `index.html?form=life`: Pollinator Paradise, ten activities.
- `index.html?form=services`: Event Management, ten activities.
- Add `activity=0` for the first activity; `activity=-1` for Meet the Lab.

Original Word artwork, crop rectangles, step wording and sequence are retained. Source page images preserve complete original layouts. Page links use the printed workbook page number (one less than the physical PDF page). The activity ranges are printed pp. 13–78 and 84–150. Interactive record fields reproduce the source prompts and tables.

The workbench includes measured-area arithmetic, learner-selected paper-pollen transfer, manual practice arrival tallies and ten-minute watch timers, equal-duration mean comparisons, budgets from learner quantities/prices, task ordering, learner-created draft venue markers, draft invitation previews, anonymous practice entry counts, readiness and handover records, and separation of estimates, paid costs and approved unpaid commitments. All rehearsal data is explicitly distinct from real field or event-day evidence. Clickable source toolkit entries include optional English browser narration.

This is a workbook rehearsal, not an ecology predictor, school approval system or actual event-delivery record. No biologic success, institutional approval or cost saving is generated. A learner-created layout is marked not to scale; it does not authorise routes or establish room capacity. No notices are distributed, purchases made or real visitors registered.

Browser-local fields use `skillos.csl8.workbook.<form>.v1`. Explicit Save merges into the canonical project record `skillos.project.pollinator-8` or `skillos.project.event-8` without removing existing project notes. There is no cross-device backend in this prototype.

Regenerate with `python private/scripts/extract-csl8-book.py --docx /path/to/book.docx --pdf /path/to/faithful-render.pdf`. Required extraction libraries: lxml, Pillow, PyMuPDF. The original full source file is not served.

Check with `node tests/csl8-model.test.cjs`, plus JavaScript syntax checks and browser interaction QA. Class 7 and Robotics remain separate and retain their existing content.
